name: open-creator-ai
description: Open-source studio for running a YouTube channel end to end — niche, branding, keywords, scripts, SEO, uploads and growth, with every deliverable written as a real file.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @open-creator/daemon & npm run dev --workspace @open-creator/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @open-creator/shared && npm run build --workspace @open-creator/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @open-creator/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @open-creator/web
